name: missing_date_filter
description: No filter for the last three months.

execution.sql:
SELECT e.full_name, c.currency_code, SUM(c.amount) AS total_spend
FROM card_transactions AS c
JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.full_name, c.currency_code
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10

findings.description: no date filter for the requested period
findings.observed_behavior: no date filter for the requested period
